error.noServer: No model server was found. Start the model on this Spark (or set a base URL) and try again.
error.connectionFailed: The tool could not reach the model server. Check the URL, the port and that the server is running.
error.noModels: The server answered but lists no models. Load a model first, or set the model name explicitly.
error.authFailed: The server rejected the API key. Enter the right key or save one for this port.
error.modelNotFound: The server does not serve that model name. Leave the model empty to auto-detect it.
note.toolChoice: This model server does not support forced tool calls (tool_choice "required"), so the scenario(s) that need it were left out of the score{{excluded}}. The run is fine; the score covers the other scenarios, so it is not directly comparable with a server that supports it.
note.excluded: {{ids}} were left out of the score by the tool (see the raw output for the reason).
validation.absolutePath: {{label}} must be an absolute path (or start with ~/)
validation.urlProtocol: {{label}} must start with http:// or https://
validation.urlCredentials: {{label}} must not contain credentials (use the API key field)
validation.systemPrompt: Use either the system prompt text or the system prompt file, not both
validation.pressure: Use either a single context pressure or a sweep, not both
validation.shortScenarios: A short run and a specific scenario list cannot be combined
validation.suite: Tick at least one suite to run
validation.pressureRequired: Set a pressure ratio or a sweep range, otherwise this is a plain tool-call run
compare.differentType: The runs are of different benchmark types.
